rules.desc: Pipeline ignores OSM lanes outside the centre extract; class defaults apply (trunk 15, primary 14). In Botanica suburban 2-lane trunk/primary roads (OSM lanes=1 or 2, two-way) render as 2+2 and are 3-5 m too wide.
rules.match: two-way kind 0 pieces with w in {14,15} whose OSM way is trunk/primary with lanes<=2 (Muncesti, Drumul Baciioului, Grenoble south, Valea Crucii)
rules.change: w = 10.5 (1+1). Exceptions verified on satellite: Decebal (z<2944 is 3+3 ~20 m; 2944-3531 ~17 m), Cuza-Voda ~12.5 and Traian ~13.5 are 2+2.

rules.desc: OSM lanes values in Botanica are not reliable on their own: lanes=1 is used on two-way roads that have 1 lane per direction; Decebal tagged lanes=2 is really 3+3/2+2.
rules.change: treat two-way lanes=1 as 2 total; do not reduce Decebal/Cuza-Voda/Traian below the values above.

notes.method: OSM Overpass (526 trunk-tertiary ways, 7519 buildings, 1160 with levels) vs world.json/packs; Esri imagery ~0.27 m/px resampled into road-aligned strips with 1 m ruler (img/*_s.jpg, montages img/m1..m12.jpg); building overlays img/b*_o.jpg, img/bsample_*.jpg.
notes.apply: Each road point has from_w = original data width; apply only to pieces with that name AND that w (protects same-named links/service roads). Near Decebal z~2944 and Dacia z~3360 neighbouring points differ: use nearest point.
notes.verified_ok: Dacia primary 10.5 oneway pair (2290,4680; 3200,5559; 4231,6521); Decebal z>3531 14; Grenoble north 14 (2+2, 13.5 m); Gradina Botanica 2-lane part 14 (~13 m); Hristo Botev 11 (~10.5); Burebista 11; Titulescu/Zelinski 6.8 oneway; Padurii 11; Calea Basarabiei oneway 10.5; Sarmizegetusa oneway 8.2.
notes.unverified: Str. Trandafirilor (tree canopy at 3 points); Kaufland/33-11 blocks near (2112,3793) are construction sites in imagery (imagery older than OSM).
notes.heights_ok: 952/966 OSM-levels-matched buildings within +-4 m; footprints align with imagery within ~1-2 m. Viaduct shows ~8 m imagery parallax (elevated), not a data error.
